title: Flat root-line and shifted rational purity source comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Use the nonnegative Tate lines [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] on schemes where $\ell$ is invertible. Their uniquely root-normalized pullback maps and inverse concatenation maps, degree-zero flat and finite-Tor single complexes, completed pullback and tensor augmentations, and even-shift comparisons determine the rational geometric source maps. Retain the original linePull, lineAdd, integral and rational line/shift maps, rational source composition, cartesian pullback square, and source base-change constructions of the rational purity coherence interface, without changing their statements or comparison data.

source.place: Canonical unshifted Tate comparisons and even-shifted source constructors; the existing auxiliary realization of the rational trace/coherence node is relocated unchanged.

proof.text: Auxiliary declarations for the geometric source comparisons: reuse the uniquely root-normalized integral line pullback of [def-sf-orientation-integral-line-comparisons]. Use the rank-one clause of [lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free] and [lem-route-coefficient-twist-line-exact] to prove the positive line flat. The proved degree-zero helpers of [lem-pur-flat-single-derived-normalization] give its K-flatness and flat terms. Reuse integralPullUnit_isIso of [def-pur-canonical-tate-comparisons] for the completed pullback augmentation. For lineSingle_finiteTor, choose an auxiliary prime p greater than l and its explicitly constructed finite-field datum; [lem-coef-integral-residue-tor] identifies the integral constructible and finite-Tor predicates, and the singleFunctorIsoCompQ transports membership of the actual twisting object from [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. No geometric characteristic hypothesis is added: the auxiliary datum is a redundant parameter of that characterization. For lineAdd_existsUnique, invert the normalized multiplication isomorphism of [lem-sf-positive-root-tensor-product]. Concatenating the two restrictions of an ordered root list is the original list, so the multiplication formula proves the required inverse formula. Conversely, the given inverse formula, linearity in the scalar coefficient (by induction on the root power) and tensor balancing imply the full two-scalar multiplication formula; uniqueness of multiplication then gives uniqueness of its inverse. This works for zero exponents as well. The even-shift addition equation is integer distributivity and Nat.cast_add. These are proofs of the auxiliary Lean declarations; the substantive trace, composition and descent obligations in the following steps remain open.

theorem lineAdd_existsUnique (T : Scheme.{u}) (d e : ℕ) :
    ∃! a : positiveLine l E T (d + e) ≅
        ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor T
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)).obj
            (positiveLine l E T d)).obj (positiveLine l E T e),
      ∀ (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (b : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T).obj.obj U)
        (x : Fin (d + e) → (purTwistZlOne T l).obj.obj U),
        a.hom.val.app U (generator l E T U b (d + e) x) =
          proEtaleTensorPair T
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
            (positiveLine l E T d) (positiveLine l E T e) U
            (generator l E T U b d (fun i ↦ x (Fin.castAdd e i)))
            (generator l E T U 1 e (fun i ↦ x (Fin.natAdd d i)))
